test: 2025, never fitted on: 52 weekly 12Z cycles and 30 cycles at each of 00Z, 03Z, 06Z, 09Z, 15Z, 18Z, 21Z
test_climatology: test-year forecasts replayed with a climatology from truth before 2025-01-01
statistic: 1 - prod(1 - p_hour)^step over the forecast hours of the target date that the cycle covers (hours after the cycle when the date is under way), exactly as build_deploy.day_stats builds it
target: at least one hourly below-CAT-I flag in the UTC date (>= 18 hourly obs); for a date under way, at an hour after the cycle (three quarters of those hours observed)
baseline: dayscale.json climo_day; for a date under way, the per-airport monthly frequency of the same part-day event over every truth year but the row's own
published: max(map(statistic), peak hourly chance), 3 decimals; an area map marked floor=false is published without the max
method: isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators), blocks under 200 station-days pooled into the block below, one breakpoint per block, linear interpolation between
min_hours: published only when at most 3 hour-equivalents of what the cycle covers are missing
rule: A (slot, bucket) publishes a day-level chance only if, on real 2025 cycles issued at the bucket's representative hour, the published chance (a) has Brier skill > 0 against climatology on the same rows and (b) the group published >= 0.5, when it has n >= 50, verifies within 10 points of its mean. Maps are fitted on 2023-2024 only; the map tested is the map shipped.
rule_by_season: Rule (b) is also read off the Nov-Feb >= 0.5 group of the passing sample (50 airport-days or more). Where it misses by more than 10 points the slot is not published for target days in November to February.
rule_by_area: Version 2's flag, kept for every field that stays on the pooled map: rule (b) is read off each area's own >= 0.5 group at the map's fit hour, on the test year and on all years, wherever that group has 50 airport-days. Where either misses by more than 10 points the day is not shown as calibrated for that area's fields; the number itself is unchanged.
rule_regional: An area gets its own map (same method, fitted on the area's rows) when, leaving each of 2023, 2024 and 2025 out in turn and pooling the three out-of-fold sets, the published chance (a) has Brier skill > 0, (b) is within 10 points at >= 0.5 when n >= 50, (c) has a lower Brier than the pooled map put through the same folds, (d) is within 10 points at 0.25-0.5 when n >= 50 and (e) has a >= 0.5 group that is empty or n >= 50. Tried floored at the peak hourly chance first, then unfloored. The map shipped is the one fitted on 2023-24; it is used in a bucket only where it also passes (a), (b) and (d) on the area's rows of that bucket's 2025 sample. 2025 had been looked at by region before this rule was written. Added after the result (it only withholds): (f) an unfloored area map replaces the pooled map only where the pooled map's >= 0.5 group in that area was judged (n >= 50) and ran high by more than 10 points.
rule_hourly: Reported, gates nothing: by area on the 2025 rows of each map's fit hour, summed expected hours against summed observed hours, and whether the hour shown as the day's peak fell below CAT I. Expected hours 'run high' ('low') when they exceed (fall short of) observed by more than 25%, judged only with at least 100 observed fog hours.
rule_after_build: Reported, gates nothing: a day under way is also scored against fog after the build is on screen (the hours after cycle hour + 1), not only after the cycle hour. Each under-way receipt carries it as after_build.
rule_area_own: Reported, gates nothing: each area's record is also taken on every bucket's own 2025 sample (slots[..].areas[..].own). The screen prints the larger miss of that and the fit hour's record.
